scientific_integrity: An explicit universal integral chain-level prism argument, separately checked by Python integer identities and finite mod-two chain ranks; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple vertex-covered undirected graphs as 2-uniform hypergraphs; normalized Γ-cubical degree two only. No vanishing for general hypergraphs, higher degrees or Box theory. Source preprint full text remained inaccessible after bounded attempts, leaving residual originality risk.
title: Universal second-homology vanishing for graph-valued \(\Gamma\)-cubes
